provenance.note: The SINGLE-FILE target (the turn-end checkFilesBatch / runMadgeSpawn lane, #3435). Two measured facts this capture pins: madge emits cycle members relative to the TARGET's directory, so a `src/a.ts` target prints `a.ts`/`b.ts` (not `src/a.ts` and not an absolute path), and it exits 1 when it found a cycle (bin/cli.js:266-267). Resolving those members against the project root yields `<root>/a.ts`, a file that does not exist (the pre-fix #3435 defect); the base is path.dirname(target) = `<root>/src`. The whole-project capture beside this one (`circular-two-file`) prints `src/a.ts` because that target IS the root. stderr is empty because --warning is inert under --json (bin/cli.js:195, #3436). Re-captured WITHOUT --warning after #3436 removed it from buildMadgeArgs: the flag was inert under --json, so stdout/stderr/exit are byte-identical, only provenance.argv moved.
